name: DSBench
why_it_matters: Mirrors a reporter's full workflow of ingesting messy datasets, running analysis, and writing an accurate takeaway.
task_shape: Agents tackle realistic data science tasks sourced from Kaggle and ModelOff, including data analysis questions and modeling challenges that require loading provided files, reasoning across them, and producing answers or reports.
signals: Tasks are grounded in real competitions with long context and multi-file inputs, closer to newsroom analysis than toy QA.
Reported frontier model accuracy is low, so it is better as a stress test than a routine benchmark.
